🔥🇲🇽 MADRAZO-LINKED FIRM CHARGED IMSS BIENESTAR 200% ABOVE MARKET FOR DIALYSIS

Zdenko, SA de CV — traced by Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit to the network of ex-PRI governor Roberto Madrazo — billed IMSS Bienestar 2,200 pesos per hemodialysis session while competitors offered the same quality for 800. The UIF identifies a broader "Medicine Cartel" that allegedly funneled millions to LatinUs, the opposition media portal.

In 2025 alone, Zdenko pulled 100 million pesos from public healthcare contracts in Puebla before IMSS Bienestar caught the scheme and redirected patients to cheaper providers.

🇲🇽🌎 CEPEDA FILLS PLAZA DE BOLÍVAR — COLOMBIA VOTES MAY 31

Iván Cepeda and indigenous vice-presidential candidate Aída Quilcué closed their Pacto Histórico campaign at the heart of Bogotá with a massive rally. Quilcué arrived with the indigenous guard holding staffs high, committing to "build peace from the territory."

Cepeda didn't flinch when Uribe attacked: "Uribismo is fascist. Neither center nor democratic — Uribe is fascist." Colombia votes in five days.

🚨🇲🇽 300 ICE DETAINEES ON HUNGER STRIKE — NJ GOVERNOR DENIED ENTRY TO HER OWN STATE

Families of migrants locked inside Delaney Hall in Newark clashed with ICE agents as 300 detainees launched a hunger and labor strike demanding their freedom. Congressional reps who entered the facility confirmed every claim of torture: insufficient food, medical neglect, inhumane conditions — including a mother separated from her 2-month-old baby and a high school student about to graduate.

When New Jersey Governor Sherrill showed up to inspect the facility, DHS denied her entry to a building in her own state.

"We are not striking for better treatment," detainees said. "We are doing this to demand freedom."

🇲🇽✊ Mexico is launching a Universal Health Credential — 2,136 enrollment modules nationwide, starting January 2027. — Secretaría de Salud, mañanera May 26 Registration by last-name letter, Mon-Sat schedule, deadline Nov 14. Benefits: emergency care, Código Infarto, Código Cerebro. Plus: 177M pesos for ISSSTE therapy rooms, new linear accelerator in Tabasco (80 patients/day).

🇲🇽✊ "We have to be close, active, informing about this offensive against us." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 Sheinbaum called on supporters to mobilize for May 31. The movement responds to a sustained media and political offensive against the Fourth Transformation government.

🇲🇽🎨 "It's called 'Grandiose Humanity' — for us as humanists, it's an exceptional title." — Claudia Sheinbaum, mañanera May 26 Sheinbaum highlighted Pope Francis' new encyclical on AI regulation. "It doesn't just talk about the importance of regulating artificial intelligence — it asks who controls it."

🇲🇽✊ Mexico's door-to-door health program has completed over 18 million home visits to elderly and disabled citizens in under a year. "Salud Casa por Casa guarantees the right to health for elderly adults and people with disabilities" — Salud Casa por Casa, mañanera May 26 Started June 2025. Three rounds: clinical records, lab screenings, preventive care. On track for 20M+ visits by year-end.
